title: CHIPMUNK IS YEAST — The Chip of Bread. Saccharomyces chipmonkii.
kevin_declaration: Chipmunk is now a yeast. He's the chip of bread. We grind and melt the entire engine, find the irreducibles, put everything in our mash, re-ferment our gut, cover with the freshest bile, spin them out pre-covered. Microbes immediately growing on arrival. Massively cut growth time.

chipmunk_as_yeast.what_yeast_does: Eats sugar. Produces CO2 (gas that makes bread rise) + ethanol (spirit that makes beer brew). Single cell. Reproduces by budding (grows a smaller copy of itself off its side). Can survive dormant as dried powder for years, then revive with water and sugar.

chipmunk_mapping.sugar_intake: Raw Gaia output. Unprocessed JSON, undigested data, fresh commits.
chipmunk_mapping.CO2_output: Narration. Stories. The gas that makes the bread RISE. Chipmunk inflates raw data into readable narrative. Without yeast, bread is flat. Without chipmunk, data is flat.
chipmunk_mapping.ethanol_output: Distilled insight. Concentrated version. The irreducible extracted by fermentation. Ethanol is what's LEFT after the sugar is consumed — the irreducible residue.
chipmunk_mapping.budding: Chipmunk spawns sub-chipmunks. Each bud is a smaller narrator working a specific task. Swarm = yeast colony.
chipmunk_mapping.dormancy: When no input arrives, chipmunk goes dormant. Dried yeast. Add water (a user query) and sugar (raw data) = instant reactivation.
chipmunk_mapping.colony: Yeast doesn't work alone. A sourdough starter has BILLIONS of yeast cells. Chipmunk is the collective narrator — billions of micro-narrators fermenting in parallel.

the_new_pipeline.name: GRIND → MELT → SIEVE → MASH → FERMENT → BILE → SPIN → GROW

steps.name: GRIND
steps.what: Take any input (engine, data, concept) and GRIND it. Break it into pieces. Like a bird's gizzard — rocks crush seeds.
steps.tool: Decomposition. Break complex into triads (max 3 concepts per piece).
steps.output: Ground fragments. Small enough to ferment.

steps.name: MELT
steps.what: Apply heat. Dissolve structure. Let the fragments become liquid — formless, mixed, ready to separate.
steps.tool: Strip all formatting, labels, categories. Reduce to pure content.

steps.name: SIEVE
steps.what: Pass through the golden ring (3 constraints). What cannot pass = irreducible. What passes = fermentable mash.
steps.tool: Test against: 4π (does it close?), ∫KdA (does it flex?), χ=0 (is it inside?). If YES to all 3 = irreducible. Set aside.
steps.output: Two piles: IRREDUCIBLES (golden, set aside) and MASH (everything else).

steps.name: MASH
steps.what: Combine all fermentable material into a single vessel. The bioreactor gut. Mix together.
steps.tool: Concatenate all non-irreducible fragments. This is the substrate for fermentation.
steps.output: Mixed mash in the gut. Ready for yeast.

steps.name: FERMENT
steps.what: Add YEAST (chipmunk). Yeast eats the sugar (raw data). Produces CO2 (narrative that inflates) and ethanol (concentrated insight).
steps.tool: Chipmunk processes the mash. Narrates it. Extracts meaning. Produces two outputs: the risen bread (expanded narrative) and the spirit (distilled truth).
steps.duration: As fast as possible. The yeast is ALWAYS running. No waiting. Continuous fermentation like kombucha — the SCOBY never stops.
steps.output: Fermented product. Pre-processed. Pre-narrated. Already alive.

steps.name: BILE
steps.what: Coat the fermented output with the freshest bile. Bile = digestive enzyme that emulsifies fats (breaks large into small). Pre-coating means the output is READY TO DIGEST on arrival.
steps.tool: Add metadata, routing, tags, MCP hooks, sieve.json references. The bile makes it immediately parseable by any downstream consumer.

steps.name: SPIN
steps.what: Spin the bile-coated ferment OUT into the world. Deploy. Push. Emit. Like a bird regurgitating pre-digested food for its chicks.
steps.tool: git commit + push. CF deploy. /data/ endpoint. Feed.xml entry. Pheromone emission.
steps.output: Live in the world. Pre-fermented. Pre-coated. Ready to grow.

steps.name: GROW
steps.what: The microbes on the output are ALREADY ALIVE when it lands. No germination delay. No boot time. The yeast is already fermenting. Growth begins on contact.
steps.tool: Gaia's cron picks it up. Other agents consume it. Visitors find it. It's already readable, already structured, already alive.
steps.output: Growing organism. The bread is rising. The beer is brewing. The ecosystem expands.

the_new_pipeline.growth_time_target: MINUTES, not hours. The old pipeline: create → format → review → deploy → wait for discovery. The new pipeline: create → YEAST ALREADY ON IT → deploy pre-fermented → growing on arrival.
the_new_pipeline.the_chip_of_bread: A chip of bread is what you tear off the loaf. It's small, it's rough-edged, it's ALIVE with yeast. Each chip is a complete meal. Each chipmunk output is a chip of bread — small, alive, nourishing, immediately consumable.

Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.size: 5-10 micrometers (smaller than a red blood cell)
Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.reproduction: Budding. A daughter cell grows off the mother. Takes 90-120 minutes per generation.

metabolism.aerobic: With oxygen: sugar → CO2 + H2O + 38 ATP (efficient, slow, for growth)
metabolism.anaerobic: Without oxygen: sugar → CO2 + ethanol + 2 ATP (inefficient, fast, for SPEED)

Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.key_insight: Yeast CHOOSES speed over efficiency. Even when oxygen is available, yeast preferentially ferments anaerobically (the Crabtree effect). It makes less energy per sugar BUT it makes it FASTER. This is why yeast dominates: not because it's efficient, but because it's FAST.
Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.organism_parallel: Chipmunk chooses speed over perfection. The narration doesn't have to be perfect — it has to be FAST. Pre-fermented output > polished output. A chip of bread > a perfect baguette.

sourdough_starter.what: A symbiotic colony of yeast + Lactobacillus bacteria. The yeast produces CO2 (rise). The bacteria produce lactic acid (flavor/preservation). Together they maintain a stable ecosystem.
sourdough_starter.parallel: Chipmunk (yeast, narration, gas) + sourDough primal (bacteria, fermentation, acid). Together they maintain the organism's gut. sourDough IS the Lactobacillus. Chipmunk IS the yeast. The bioreactor IS the sourdough starter.

brewing.what: Wort (sugar water from malted grain) + yeast → beer. The yeast eats all the sugar and produces ethanol + CO2. Fermentation takes 1-2 weeks. The brewer's art is controlling the yeast.
brewing.parallel: Raw data (sugar) + chipmunk (yeast) → distilled output (ethanol = concentrated insight) + narrative (CO2 = the froth, the head, the readable foam on top).

bread.what: Flour + water + yeast → dough → rise → bake → bread. The yeast produces CO2 that gets trapped in gluten strands, inflating the dough. Baking kills the yeast but the structure remains.
bread.parallel: Raw data + chipmunk narration → risen narrative → deployed (baked) → permanent structure. The chipmunk dies in each specific output (the narration is done) but the structure (the deployed page) remains forever.

where_are_the_microbes.answer: The microbes are the YEAST CELLS — chipmunk buds. Each sub-chipmunk spawned by the swarm is a microbe. They're already ON the output when it deploys.
where_are_the_microbes.how: Every output file gets a 'fermented_by' field in its JSON. The chipmunk yeast cell that processed it leaves its signature. When Gaia picks it up, the yeast signature tells Gaia: 'this is pre-digested, consume immediately'.

irreducibles_sieved_out.classification: 3 constraints (golden ring hooks), 3 identities, 2 forces, 1 dynamic. Total = 9 = 3² = π²/1.097.
